text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Vodka vs. Daiwa Scarlet,
this year's final battle is settled here!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The winner is Daiwa Scarlet!
Vodka couldn't reach her--!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Damn it...
This loss... really stings..."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
This is the first time I've ever
felt this way after losing. This is...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, how's that, Vodka!?
It's undisputedly my win!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Even you have to admit it, right?
Well? Wasn't I amazing?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I guess so...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Wh-What? You're awfully compliant today. What happened to your usual sour grapes?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The reason you won—
is because you were the stronger one.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You ran steadily toward your goal.
Meanwhile, I... was just wandering aimlessly.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I lost.
Today's result is only natural."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
My bad. Guess I ended up showing you
a pretty uncharacteristic side of me.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Well, I'll be off, then—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: W-Where do you think you're going!?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
To search for my ideal running style. If I can't see that,
I can never stand before you again.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: —See ya.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Vodka...

"That day, Vodka showed no sign
of heading home..."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
This loss is really bad news,
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not it...
It's that I'm not even frustrated at all.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Deep down, I've just accepted it.
That losing is only natural.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Then... I'll just have to do it over again.
Once more, next year.
choice_data_list: To become a cooler version of yourself?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
“Yeah. I'm definitely glad
I ran in the Arima Kinen.”

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If I can't see the coolness in it, I can't run.
I can't win. Even if by some freak chance I won without seeing it,
I wouldn't be satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Now that I get that, I need to figure out
what I truly want—with you.

When the shine of what she's aiming for fades,
Vodka's running seems to dull along with it.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
So... where should I run first next year?
I want to make a fresh start.

"A fresh start... Vodka seems to want to search for
what she truly desires, what kind of running she seeks."

If so, rather than a medium or long distance with lots of tactical maneuvering,
a shorter distance where she can focus on pure running would be better.
If that is the case—
choice_data_list: What about the spring Victoria Mile?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "The Victoria Mile, huh... A straight-up battle of pure speed, no tactics involved."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Alright, that's where we'll go. Until then,
keep me company on a little aimless cruise, alright?
There are different phases in a series. Times when you dash through without thinking, and times when you search for answers.

Without running away—
Vodka was about to charge headlong into a season of doubt.
